author: China Insights
description:
Putin's new rule is shocking! The Chinese consulate waited over 100 days to post a no-blame reminder: If you want to live in Russia for a long time, you have to sign a contract with the Russian army and serve for at least one year! Chinese people who went to Russia as hired soldiers regret it, but there's no way out.
